summary.whatChanges: Makes static parsing the default for test collection: `vitest list` and the programmatic `Vitest.collect()` now statically analyse test files instead of executing them, with `--no-static-parse` to opt back into running files. Docs and e2e snapshots updated accordingly.
behaviorChanges: `vitest list` now collects tests via static parsing by default; `--no-static-parse` restores the previous run-based behavior
`Vitest.collect(filters, options)` defaults to static parsing when `staticParse` is not explicitly `false`
`vitest list --json` output now includes a `location` object (line/column) for each test
Test ordering changed in typecheck listing output (e.g. `type.test-d.ts` now appears last)
CLI help text and docs mark `staticParse` as default `true` and no longer experimental
risks: Static analysis cannot resolve dynamically generated tests (loops, helpers, computed names), so collected lists may differ from actual runs
Errors that only surface when executing test files may no longer be reported during collection — the error-output e2e test had to add `--no-static-parse`
Changed default is a breaking change for scripts/tools parsing `vitest list` output, which now includes `location` and different ordering
Programmatic callers relying on `collect()` executing files must now explicitly pass `staticParse: false`
